title: Vulnerabilities in Armadok
explain: Known weaknesses in the software Armadok runs on, from the public OSV database. Only the names and versions of the packages are sent, once a day.
off: The check is off. Set ARMADOK_VULN_CHECK=true to turn it on: nothing is sent to the database until you do.
none: No known vulnerability in the packages checked.
scanTip: Looks the components up again in the public database now
acceptTip: Keep using it knowingly: write down why, so the next person understands.
